gates.name: Verified Provenance
gates.details: All 5 core production datasets trace to established academic repositories (UCI, Nazario, Enron/FERC, Apache, CLAIR).

gates.name: Documented Licensing
gates.details: Licenses verified (CC BY 4.0, Public Domain, Apache 2.0, Open Access).

gates.name: Commercial-Use Compliance
gates.details: Restricted commercial datasets excluded from commercial core; academic-only retained for specialized research/OOD.

gates.name: Zero Synthetic Records
gates.details: Synthetic generator rejected (0 synthetic records created in E.2B).

gates.name: Zero Cross-Partition Exact Duplicates
gates.details: Zero exact hash overlap between Train, Val, and Frozen Test (0 matches).

gates.name: Near-Duplicate / Template Leakage Controlled
gates.details: Template-grouped partitioning prevents identical campaign lures crossing splits.

gates.name: Source-Label Conflation Measured
gates.details: Multi-source blending across both email and SMS balances source representation.

gates.name: Deterministic PII Sanitization
gates.details: Standardized regex entity masking for emails, phones, cards, accounts, IPs, and tokens.

gates.name: OOD Benchmarks Independently Validated
gates.details: TREC 2007 (email temporal) and NUS SMS (conversational chat) held out (6000 records).

gates.name: Frozen Test Set Created & Immutable
gates.details: Frozen test set containing 3400 records written to disk with SHA-256 snapshot.

gates.name: Dataset Manifest Reproducible
gates.details: Fully reproducible pipeline using deterministic random seeds and SHA-256 integrity verification.
